Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • IPA(key): /diθjoˈnaɾjo/ [d̪i.θjoˈna.ɾjʊ]
  • IPA(key): (standard) /diθjoˈnaɾjo/ [d̪i.θjoˈna.ɾjʊ]
  • IPA(key): (seseo) /disjoˈnaɾjo/ [d̪i.sjoˈna.ɾjʊ]

  • Rhymes: -aɾjo
  • Hyphenation: di‧cio‧ná‧rio

Noun

[edit]

dicionário m (plural dicionários, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of diccionario

References

[edit]
  • “dicionário”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • diccionario, diccionário, dicionario (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *deyḱ-
Proto-Indo-European *déyḱeti
Proto-Italic *deikō
Latin dīcō
Proto-Indo-European *-tisder.
Proto-Italic *-tjō
Latin -tiō
Latin dictiō
Proto-Indo-European *-yósder.
Proto-Italic *-āsios
Latin -ārius
Latin -ārium
Latin dictiōnāriumlbor.
Portuguese dicionário

    Learned borrowing from Medieval Latin dictiōnārium, from dictiō (“speaking”) +‎ -ārium (“room, place”). By surface analysis, dição +‎ -ário. Compare French dictionnaire.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.si.oˈna.ɾi.u/ [d͡ʒi.sɪ.oˈna.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.sjoˈna.ɾju/
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.si.oˈna.ɾi.u/ [d͡ʒi.sɪ.oˈna.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.sjoˈna.ɾju/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /d͡ʒi.si.oˈna.ɾi.o/ [d͡ʒi.sɪ.oˈna.ɾɪ.o], (faster pronunciation) /d͡ʒi.sjoˈna.ɾjo/
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /di.sjuˈna.ɾju/

    • Rhymes: -aɾiu, -aɾju
    • Hyphenation: di‧ci‧o‧ná‧ri‧o

    Noun

    [edit]

    dicionário m (plural dicionários)

    1. dictionary (reference work with a list of words)
